ModifyReplicationZone.isDefer: Whether to execute during the maintenance window. <li>true: execute during the maintenance window <li>false: execute immediately
ModifyReplicationZone.replicationInfo: Replica information. Full replica information is required; the availability zone and subnet can be modified.
ModifyReplicationZone.replicationInfo.isMaster: Whether it is the master node. There is one and only one master node. <li>1: master node <li>0: slave node
